mentions.name: NPSBeacon
mentions.description: This tool lets users run and analyze NPS (Net Promoter Score) surveys, offering an easy and cost-effective way to manage NPS surveys compared to expensive competitors.
mentions.problem: Existing NPS survey and analysis competitors charge far too much, and the author needed an easy, cost-effective way to manage NPS surveys.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://npsbeacon.com
NPS survey and analysis tool. I built this because I needed an easy and cost effective way to manage NPS surveys and almost had a heart attack when I learned what some of the competitors are charging.
